description: The tutorial progress a save keeps and a load restores (PL.tutorial-progress-save, U97(4); catalog onboarding-tutorial-quest, onboarding-flow): TutorialQuestSystem.saveProgress() and TutorialQuestConfig.progress, OnboardingManager.saveProgress() and its progress option, over the block readTutorialBlock reads from currentState.extensions.tutorial (src/quests/tutorial-save.ts). How the block rides in the save file, and its refusal, are conformance/saves/village-state.json's. Runner: src/quests/tutorial-progress-corpus.ts (ops tutorial, onboarding). Compared as the village-state corpus compares: exactly, object key sets included. Regenerate with npm run tutorial-progress-corpus; npm run tutorial-progress-corpus:check fails on any difference.
sources: New in core (PL.tutorial-progress-save): the Unreal P8 landing (run 7, p8-unreal) found tutorial progress missing from core's save. Inputs are synthetic; every expected is core's answer.
The lessons, events and bindings are conformance/quests/tutorial.json's (P8.core); its cases are unchanged.

contract.saveRule: saveProgress() = {completed: the objectives the player completed, skipped: the objectives a skip passed (each in the tutorial's order, then any a restored save named that this tutorial does not run, in the save's order), current: the current objective, null once the tutorial is over, endedBySkip: a skip ended it}. The manager's, before start: the progress it was given (a copy), or null when it was given none (the save carries the stored block untouched).
contract.loadRule: progress restores without raising anything: completed objectives are done, skipped ones done by a skip, and the first objective left in the tutorial's order is current; start() announces it, and the clock (startedAt, durations) counts from that start. current null restores a tutorial that is over (endedBySkip as saved), passing as skipped any objective the save does not name. Ids the tutorial does not run are kept for saveProgress().
contract.freshRule: no block (stored absent: a new game's save or one written before the block; or null, the registry default after migrateExtensions) is no progress: the tutorial starts fresh, its first lesson current.
contract.readRule: readable: an object; completed and skipped absent ([]) or lists of non-empty ids, no repeat, no id in both; current required, null or a non-empty id in neither list; endedBySkip absent (false) or a boolean, true only when current is null and skipped names an objective. Otherwise {read: {ok: false, keys}}, keys = the unreadable members (completed, completed[<i>], skipped, skipped[<i>], current, endedBySkip) in ascending string order (empty when the block is not an object), and no tutorial is built.

cases.name: save: a new tutorial saved before it starts keeps nothing done and its first lesson current
cases.note: A new game's first autosave can come before the tutorial starts; the block says the first lesson is current.

cases.name: save: three lessons done, the fourth current
cases.note: completed lists the lessons in the tutorial's order; current is the lesson the HUD shows.

cases.name: save: a skip in the language flow keeps the skipped lessons apart and the arrival assessment current
save: a skip that ends the tutorial saves it over, ended by the skip
save: every lesson done by the player saves it over, not ended by a skip
load: the saved lessons stay done, the saved current lesson is current, and construction raises nothing
cases.note: start() announces the restored lesson (stepIndex 3); a lesson already done is never announced again.

cases.name: load: the clock starts again at the restored start(), not at the saved game's
cases.note: startedAt is the restored start (T0 + 5 s); the restored lesson took 2 s. Times are not kept in the save.

cases.name: load: an earlier lesson's event does nothing; only the current lesson completes
load: skipped lessons stay skipped and the arrival assessment is current; a skip never passes it
load: the CEFR self-select path on a restored language tutorial skips only the lessons left; the done ones stay completed
load: a tutorial a skip ended loads over, ended by the skip, and announces nothing
load: a finished tutorial loads over even when the game now teaches a lesson the save does not name, which is passed as skipped
load: an unfinished save where the game now teaches a new lesson: the first lesson the save does not name as done is current
cases.note: tut_inventory sits before tut_menu in the tutorial's order and the save does not name it done, so it is current; current only says the tutorial was not over.

cases.name: load: a lesson the save names but this game leaves out is kept, and saved again after the ones it runs
cases.note: CONTROL_BINDINGS binds neither inventory nor attack, so neither lesson runs here; a re-save must not lose them.

cases.name: load: the restored tutorial plays on to the end and saves over
load refused: an unreadable block builds no tutorial
cases.note: readVillageSave refuses the save (unreadable_tutorial); every unreadable member is named, in ascending order.

cases.name: old save: a save written before tutorial progress was kept (no tutorial key) starts the tutorial fresh
old save: a migrated older save (the registry default, null) starts the tutorial fresh
cases.note: migrateExtensions fills a key a save predates with its default, null.

cases.name: new game: a new game's flow starts fresh; saved before start it reports nothing, so the new save carries no block
cases.note: A new game writes into an empty save document; a null saveProgress() leaves it without a tutorial block, and a later save stores the flow.

cases.name: load (onboarding): the flow resumes at the saved step, and its callbacks count from the restored start
cases.note: Before start, saveProgress() is the progress the manager was given.

cases.name: load (onboarding): a definition's external step saved current is current again, and the host completes it
load (onboarding): a restored flow skips the steps left, and saves over, ended by the skip
load (onboarding): a flow a skip ended calls onCompleted on start and raises nothing
